technique_name: How do you setup a conference call?
description: Setting up a conference call requires setting up a conference line for multiple people to dial in to, creating a call agenda, choosing a time, and setting up any other necessary audio-visual components. First, you will need to choose a conference line provider that best meets your needs and provide the necessary access codes so that people can dial in and join the call.
